sloka: एवं बहुविधं वाच्यो रामो दाशरथिस्त्वया ।यथा मामाप्नुयाच्छीघ्रं हत्वा रावणमाहवे ।। ५.६८.२ ।।।।
transliteration: evaṁ bahuvidhaṁ vācyo rāmo dāśarathistvayā ।yathā māmāpnuyācchīghraṁ hatvā rāvaṇamāhave ।। 5.68.2 ।।।।

translations.english: 'You may appeal to Rama, the son of Dasaratha in many ways, that he should come quickly and slay Ravana in the battle and get me back.
